root_cause: uv sync prepared the host development environment but did not guarantee the resolver/wheel cache required by uv pip install --offline for the artifact target. CI could not resolve lxml==6.1.3 from that cache; earlier local checks used a warmed developer cache.
fix: Explicit --prepare-wheels stage derives packaged dependency names from unit.json and exact versions from uv.lock. Preparation and offline build use the same installer/target flags. Only explicit preparation enables downloads; build/smoke also receive UV_OFFLINE=true in CI.
limits: Smokes use moto and Spark/Glue stubs; no real AWS/Spark validation. Corrected remote CI is pending a separately authorised push; no CI rerun was requested.
provenance: Build/smoke were executed before the local fix commit; smoke metadata honestly records baseline + dirty=true. Source hashes below identify changed build inputs. The local commit containing this evidence completes the fix; all runtime artifact hashes equal the published baseline.
